meta.name: rules
meta.description: Use when the user asks about Codex Rules behavior, injected project rules, supported rule file locations, matching, or environment configuration.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 查询和配置 Codex Rules 的行为与规则文件
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要了解或调整 Codex 的规则行为
copy.tagline_en: Query and configure Codex Rules behavior and rule files
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to understand or adjust Codex rule behavior

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会在会话开始时自动注入项目规则文件中的指令，并在代码修改后自动匹配文件特定的规则。这些规则会作为额外上下文传递，但不会改写工具的输出。
howto.when: 当用户询问关于项目规则文件位置、规则匹配行为或环境变量配置等问题时，技能会触发。

say.text: 当前项目使用了哪些规则文件？
say.note: Claude会列出所有生效的规则源。
通过环境变量调整规则源。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude automatically injects static project instructions at session start and on every user prompt submit. After applying patches, it injects matching file-specific rules. Dynamic outputs are added as context, deduplicated per session.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks about project rule file locations, rule matching behavior, or environment configuration variables.

say_en.text: Which rule files are active in this project?
say_en.note: Claude lists all enabled rule sources.

say_en.text: Set me up to only use CONTEXT.md and .omo/rules.
say_en.note: Adjusts rule sources via environment variable.
